label.text: This build has no edge link. The Maximal and Enterprise packages have it.
The edge link starts with the HTTPS listener, and it is not running in this process.
This node is an edge node. Local nodes pair with it in Edge Clients.

This node is not paired with an edge node. An edge node is a small server in the cloud that gives this node a public presence. This node dials out to it and keeps one link open, so it needs no open port or fixed address.
Make a pairing code on the edge node, in System, Edge Clients, then pair with it here.

link.confirmation: Unpair from ${edge.edgeName}? The link closes on both sides, and pairing again needs a new code.

label.text: ${lastError || 'This node stopped linking to the edge node.'}

This node stops when the edge node's link key no longer matches its pin, and the edge node refuses this node when it was revoked there. Unpair, make a new pairing code on the edge node, and pair again.
